tips.text: Bank Aya and buy relics whenever you can; neither expires when Varzia's stock rotates.
Buy extra Blueprint relics; every one carries it as the Rare, and it is the bottleneck.
Buy her relics from the Market console on your Orbiter to skip the trip to Maroo's Bazaar.
Refine Rare and Uncommon relics to Radiant but leave Common relics Intact; Radiant lowers their Common odds.
Squad up with Radiant relics for the Rares and pick a teammate's identical reward for 5 bonus Void Traces.
